overview.description: The Xtrackers Cybersecurity Select Equity ETF (PSWD) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Solactive Cyber Security Focus index. The fund tracks a market cap-weighted index of companies globally that are engaged in the cybersecurity industry. PSWD was launched on Jul 13, 2023 and is issued by Xtrackers.
